proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d z₁ z₂ z₃ z₄ hdet d1 d2 d3 d4 h14 h23
  intro T
  have hdiff : ∀ x y : ℂ, c * x + d ≠ 0 → c * y + d ≠ 0 → T x - T y = (a * d - b * c) * (x - y) / ((c * x + d) * (c * y + d)) := by
    intro x y hx hy
    simp only [T]
    rw [div_sub_div _ _ hx hy]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hdiff z₁ z₃ d1 d3, hdiff z₂ z₄ d2 d4, hdiff z₁ z₄ d1 d4, hdiff z₂ z₃ d2 d3]
  have s14 : z₁ - z₄ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h14
  have s23 : z₂ - z₃ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h23
  generalize c * z₁ + d = A₁ at d1 ⊢
  generalize c * z₂ + d = A₂ at d2 ⊢
  generalize c * z₃ + d = A₃ at d3 ⊢
  generalize c * z₄ + d = A₄ at d4 ⊢
  generalize a * d - b * c = E at hdet ⊢
  generalize z₁ - z₄ = u at s14 ⊢
  generalize z₂ - z₃ = v at s23 ⊢
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (a b c d z₁ z₂ z₃ z₄ : ℂ), a * d - b * c ≠ 0 → c * z₁ + d ≠ 0 → c * z₂ + d ≠ 0 → c * z₃ + d ≠ 0 → c * z₄ + d ≠ 0 → z₁ ≠ z₄ → z₂ ≠ z₃ → (let T : ℂ → ℂ := fun w => (a * w + b) / (c * w + d); ((T z₁ - T z₃) * (T z₂ - T z₄)) / ((T z₁ - T z₄) * (T z₂ - T z₃)) = ((z₁ - z₃) * (z₂ - z₄)) / ((z₁ - z₄) * (z₂ - z₃)))
